name: Direct cached parent origin with formatted branch

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Retry the single direct cached-parent-origin mechanism from experiment 25 using rustfmt's exact continuation layout in the initial patch. Read `absolute_outer_origins` first and recurse only on a miss, preserving arbitrary child-first calls while removing the measured 1,005 redundant bounds-map probes in the warmed DataTable frame.

Run package formatting first, all 456 gpui tests, two sequential 52/52 gpui_wgpu diagnostics suites, diagnostics-off/on native checks, single-thread WASM diagnostics check, warning-denied Clippy, and three candidate browser processes. reportMarkdown:
## Direct Cached Parent Origin Finished

**Index:** 26
**Checkpoint:** `8ebeb5362003ab729fe8d6e7a0cfd520100f8c87`
**Result Commit:** none
**Attempt Count:** 1

### Report

**Passed Status:** false. The mechanism removed exactly the predicted work and preserved behavior, but all four product medians regressed.

| Metric | Checkpoint | Candidate | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| DPR 1 acknowledged steps/s | 30.1435 | 29.9430 | -0.67% |
| DPR 2 acknowledged steps/s | 30.0764 | 30.0031 | -0.24% |
| DPR 1 paced p95 | 27.2993 ms | 27.9185 ms | +2.27% |
| DPR 2 paced p95 | 27.1262 ms | 27.7639 ms | +2.35% |

Exact telemetry proved 1,005 fewer helper calls and bounds-map hits in every warmed frame. The direct-origin lookup and cold fallback nevertheless did not improve end-to-end performance.

### Decision

Reject and revert. Retain the existing recursive cached-bounds path because the simpler measured-work count did not translate into product performance.
decisionMarkdown: Reject and revert. Exact work reduction was insufficient: acknowledged throughput regressed at both DPRs and paced p95 worsened by more than 2% at both DPRs. Preserve the stable recursive lookup implementation.
notes: No source or memory change remains. No gpux skill reference change was warranted.
